name: MahaLend
summary: MahaLend, an Aave v3 fork, had an empty USDC reserve. The attacker supplied a dust amount, inflated the liquidity index by repeated flash loans whose premiums accrued to its lone deposit, borrowed ARTH against the inflated collateral and withdrew the USDC through rounding that burned fewer shares than owed.
notes: Reset is the reserve configuration that gave USDC its collateral LTV and enabled ARTH borrowing, 26 blocks after the Pool proxy. Later edits (USDC eMode category, liquidation fees, ARTH unfreeze a week before the exploit) were not needed or are pause-type gates; the USDC reserve becoming empty was user withdrawals.
